Complete React Guide

By Jane Doe · 8 min read

React changed how teams build user interfaces. This guide walks through the essentials you need to ship real apps.

What is React?

React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces from small, reusable components.

React was created at Facebook and released as open source in 2013.

Why use React?

  • Declarative views
  • Component reuse
  • Huge ecosystem
Teams adopt React because it scales from a widget to a whole product.
